writtenBefore: any NS-02 pipeline change, prompt change or model run on this case (NS-02, ops/notes/ns-02-facts-contract-and-cases.md)
description: One business rule, the 30-day refund window, implemented in two contexts with different shapes and units: `days <= 30` (whole days) in returns, and `!(nowMs - purchasedAtMs > REFUND_WINDOW_MS)` with 2,592,000,000 ms in support. 30 and 2,592,000,000 are not equal up to a power of ten, so the deterministic verifier cannot confirm it: the expected finding is a model-only duplication (verified: false). This tests the edge of propose-interpret-verify that case-01 does not.

ruleDuplications.rule: A purchase can be returned or refunded within 30 days.

cheapExpectation.why: No shared literal (30 vs 2592000000), different shape, different identifiers.

ns02.knowledgeLevel: K2m (same rule, different shape AND different unit)
ns02.layers: layers.json in this directory (declares the DDD contexts)

expectedFacts.subject: RefundEligibilityService.isRefundable
expectedFacts.note: threshold 30 with unit days is equally correct

expectedFacts.subject: ReturnPolicy.accepts
expectedFacts.note: no decimal-scale match; unit conversion is outside the v0 verifier

ns02.harnessStatus: Findable by the current pipeline if the pass-(d) candidate matcher pairs the two rules (same operator and either equal-up-to-scale thresholds or subject Jaccard >= 0.5). If the model states one in days and one in ms with different subjects, no pair is proposed and the case is missed for a matcher reason, not a model reason; the run report must say which.
ns02.factPolarity: required: the run must produce it (agreed); forbidden: producing it is a false fact; tolerated: either answer, the verdict must not depend on it. Subjects are APG names (Class or Class.method), as in the mock-answer scripts.
